videos.filename: Tornado caught on CCTV at St Louis Lambert International Airport 4-22-2011.webm
videos.caption: A security camera captured the moment a tornado struck St. Louis Lambert International Airport in St. Louis, Missouri. The tornado was rated EF4 with winds of 170 mph per the National Weather Service.
